samples.user_input: What is the liability cap in the Master Services Agreement?
samples.reference: The liability cap shall not exceed $1,000,000 in aggregate for all claims arising under this agreement. This limitation applies to both direct and indirect damages.
reference_contexts: The liability cap shall not exceed $1,000,000 in aggregate for all claims arising under this agreement. This limitation applies to both direct and indirect damages.

samples.user_input: How many days of notice are required to terminate the MSA?
samples.reference: Either party may terminate the MSA with 30 days written notice.
reference_contexts: Either party may terminate this MSA with 30 days written notice to the other party.

samples.user_input: What is the governing law for this agreement?
samples.reference: The agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
reference_contexts: This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.

samples.user_input: What protections does the confidentiality clause provide?
samples.reference: The confidentiality clause obligates both parties to protect proprietary and non-public information disclosed during the engagement, restricts its use to the purposes of the agreement, and survives termination for a defined period.
reference_contexts: Each party shall treat as confidential all non-public information disclosed by the other party and shall not use such information except as required to perform its obligations under this agreement.
The confidentiality obligations set forth herein shall survive termination of this agreement for a period of five (5) years.

samples.user_input: Under what circumstances can the service provider suspend services?
samples.reference: The service provider may suspend services if the client fails to pay undisputed invoices within the cure period, or if continued performance would violate applicable law.
reference_contexts: Provider may suspend services upon written notice if Client fails to pay any undisputed invoice within fifteen (15) days of the payment due date.
Provider may suspend services where continued performance would violate applicable law or regulation.

samples.user_input: How do the termination clauses differ between the MSA and the NDA?
samples.reference: The MSA allows either party to terminate with 30 days written notice, while the NDA requires 60 days notice and mutual consent.
reference_contexts: Either party may terminate this MSA with 30 days written notice to the other party.
Termination of this NDA requires 60 days written notice and mutual consent of both parties.

samples.user_input: What fees are defined across the agreement, and when are they payable?
samples.reference: The agreement defines monthly subscription fees and optional professional services fees. Subscription fees are payable in advance on the first day of each month; professional services fees are invoiced upon milestone completion with net-30 terms.
reference_contexts: Subscription Fees shall be invoiced in advance and are due on the first day of each calendar month.
Professional Services Fees shall be invoiced upon completion of the applicable milestone and payable net thirty (30) days.

samples.user_input: If a data breach occurs on day 10 of a monthly billing cycle, when does the provider need to notify the client by?
samples.reference: The provider must notify the client within 72 hours of discovering the breach, so notification is required by day 13 of the same billing cycle.
reference_contexts: Provider shall notify Client in writing within seventy-two (72) hours of discovering any security incident or data breach affecting Client Data.

samples.user_input: A client wants to assign the agreement to its parent company. Is that permitted without consent?
samples.reference: No. Assignment requires the prior written consent of the other party, except that a party may assign the agreement to an affiliate or successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets. A parent-company assignment qualifies as an affiliate assignment and does not require consent.
reference_contexts: Neither party may assign this agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, except that either party may assign this agreement to an affiliate or successor in interest in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.
